items.quote: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
items.claim: Isaac questioned Abraham about the absence of the lamb for the burnt offering

items.quote: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering
items.claim: Abraham stated that God will provide a lamb for the burnt offering

items.quote: so they went both of them together
